summary: Institutional positioning is aggressively bullish, characterized by massive call buying in semiconductor stocks (AMD, MU, AAPL) and extreme call dominance in SPX/SPXW (P/C ratios as low as 0.08–0.17). Notable directional conviction is evident in the heavy accumulation of long-dated AMD 250C (2026) for $270.5M and massive SPX/SPXW calls targeting strikes between 6000 and 8030 for 2026-2030 expirations. Persistent interest is anchored by multi-day accumulation in the SPX 6000C (exp 2026) totaling over $3.4B, signaling a long-term structural bullish bias. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor sector and monitor if the SPX 6000 level holds as the primary institutional floor.
